title: Vials, HotKeys and a synth to play
thisBuild: Keys: the lamp moved into the metal lip under each key, so the word and icon sit in the middle. Keys that only do something (Stop, Undo, plus, minus, Hear it) have no lamp. Icons are as big as the key allows, and keys grow with a wide screen.
HotKeys in Settings: what a quick swipe off a pad opens. Out of the box up is the Edit tray, down the Padiano, left Sample, right FX. Each direction can be anything, or nothing.

FX are glass vials now, every effect at once. Drag a vial to fill it. The lamp under it takes that effect out and puts it back where it was; hold the lamp for its Auto lane. Bypass takes them all out and brings them back exactly.
Perform: the throws are vials on a brass master plate. Where your finger lands is how much, slide to change it. Tap a name for its settings.
Mutes: tap LOOP on the top bar on any page. Under the loops: pad mutes (lit is heard) and the whole bank. Perform has loops and mutes on the page itself, so the strip stays off there.
Synth opens on a scratch synth you can play right away, on no pad. Pick a kind and preset, turn the knobs, play the keys, then Put it on a pad.
Chords on with no Padiano out opens the picked pad's. The key reads out on an amber LCD. BAR on the loops is now Wait bar or Now (it never added bars: Seq, Steps, the 1 bar key does).
watch: Play with swipes on: does down for the Padiano ever fire when you only meant to hit a pad?
Throw vials while the loop plays: does landing low feel like a little and the top like all of it?
On the Fold's inner screen: do the keys look full size now, not small and far apart?
limits: Bypass and each vial's in or out are live only: a reload brings every effect back in.
Muting a sound mutes it on every pad that has it.
The scratch synth has no Granular (it reads a sound off a pad) and no Full knobs; put it on a pad for those.
A left swipe that starts right at the screen's edge is Android's Back, not Sample.
One dock idea for the whole app is planned, not built: today mutes ride under the loops strip.
